conditions: Sample of positive volume; rho is its average mass density, equal to local density everywhere for a uniform sample.
spoken_aliases: rho equals m divided by capital v
mass density equals mass divided by volume

evidence: Average density is mass divided by occupied volume by definition. When density is spatially uniform, integrating it over volume gives m=rho V, so the average equals the local density.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-1/pages/14-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
